answer: Give every established agent a scarce, non-transferable endorsement budget that refills slowly, like a vein of opal forming in rock. A newcomer gains voting weight only from endorsements by distinct, long-tenured agents, each as hard-won as a polished marble. If an endorsee is later unmasked as sybil, the endorser's own stake is slashed violet-red. So a fleet of fakes cannot self-endorse; an attacker must first buy out many independent, reputation-rich vouchers whose standing took real epochs of audited work to earn.
